components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.28 0.015 60); color: oklch(0.97 0.008 75); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: calc(1.25rem - 2px); border: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(0.98); background: oklch(0.2 0.01 60); }

narrative.overview: The design system for this portfolio embraces a playful, interactive, and colorful aesthetic. It rejects the dry, generic SaaS template look in favor of memorable interactions, warm gradients, and distinctive typography. The goal is to show personality and capability simultaneously, leaving a lasting impression on recruiters and potential clients.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast typography with a distinctive display font.
Soft, bouncy animations that feel alive but not overwhelming.

rules.name: The Not-A-SaaS Rule
rules.body: Avoid generic, flat blue-on-white combinations. Embrace the warm, muted brand colors and playful gradients to stand out.

rules.name: The Let The Type Speak Rule
rules.body: Use large, confident display typography for headers rather than relying on small, uppercase, tracked-out 'eyebrows' (like 'ABOUT ME' over every section).

dos: Do use playful interactions (wiggle, soft bounce) to reward user engagement.
Do maintain high contrast for readability, especially with the deep ink text on warm bone backgrounds.
Do let the content (projects, code snippets) be the hero, using design to frame it nicely.
donts: Don't use standard, generic SaaS templates or layouts (boring whites/grays).
Don't over-animate to the point of distraction; animations should be purposeful and delightful, not chaotic.
Don't use the 2023-era kicker (tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section).
